# ProgramCard

A program (workshop, masterclass, membership) with a cover, badges, price, details and one action.

```tsx
import { ProgramCard } from '@kafka/react'
```

## When to use it

- To list what can be enrolled in, in a grid of two or three.
- `highlight="featured"` for the one program to push; `highlight="vip"` for the membership.

## When not to

- More than one `vip` card in view: the shine stops meaning anything.
- A card without a way forward: always give it one action.
- Long descriptions: two sentences; the details go in the list.

## Examples

### With a generated cover

No image yet? The card draws a cover from an icon and a tone. The title always sits on the darkest part, so it stays readable.

```tsx
<div className="max-w-md">
  <ProgramCard
    title="Taller de poesía"
    subtitle="Con Gabriel Rodríguez"
    cover={{ Icon: IconPen, tone: 'gold' }}
    badges={<Badge tone="success">Inscripciones abiertas</Badge>}
    price="$200.000"
    description="Diez sesiones para escribir, leer en voz alta y revisar tus propios poemas."
    meta={meta}
    action={<Button block>Inscribirme</Button>}
  />
</div>
```

### With an image

`image.alt` is required: a program cover is content, so it needs a description.

```tsx
<div className="max-w-md">
  <ProgramCard
    title="Masterclass de cuento"
    image={{ src: '/portada.svg', alt: 'Cuaderno abierto con un manuscrito' }}
    cover={{ Icon: IconPen, tone: 'blue' }}
    price="$80.000"
    description="Una sesión para pensar el cuento desde el final."
    meta={meta.slice(0, 2)}
    action={<Button block>Inscribirme</Button>}
  />
</div>
```

### Image that fails to load

A broken `image.src` falls back to the generated cover, so the card never shows a broken picture.

```tsx
<div className="max-w-md">
  <ProgramCard
    title="Laboratorio de lectura"
    image={{ src: '/no-existe.jpg', alt: 'Lámpara sobre un libro' }}
    cover={{ Icon: IconPen, tone: 'green' }}
    description="Leemos juntos un libro durante la temporada."
    action={<Button block variant="outline">Ver detalles</Button>}
  />
</div>
```

### Featured

`highlight="featured"` adds the brand-coloured border to the one program that should stand out.

```tsx
<div className="max-w-md">
  <ProgramCard
    highlight="featured"
    title="Taller de narrativa"
    cover={{ Icon: IconPen, tone: 'amber' }}
    badges={<Badge tone="warning">Últimos cupos</Badge>}
    price="$200.000"
    description="Construimos una historia desde el primer párrafo hasta la revisión final."
    meta={meta}
    action={<Button block>Inscribirme</Button>}
  />
</div>
```

### VIP

`highlight="vip"` is the membership: a gold card with a crown badge and a shining edge. Use the `vip` button inside it.

```tsx
<div className="max-w-md">
  <ProgramCard
    highlight="vip"
    title="Membresía anual"
    subtitle="Todo Altazor, todo el año"
    cover={{ Icon: IconPen, tone: 'gold' }}
    price="$1.800.000"
    description="Acceso a todos los talleres, masterclasses y laboratorios, y a la biblioteca de grabaciones."
    action={<Button variant="vip" block>Hacerme miembro</Button>}
  />
</div>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` (required) | `string` |  | The program's name. Rendered as a heading. |
| `subtitle` | `string` |  | Who leads it, or a short tagline. |
| `image` | `{ src: string; alt: string }` |  | A cover photo. `alt` is required. A broken `src` falls back to `cover`. |
| `cover` | `{ Icon: IconType; tone?: CoverTone }` |  | A generated cover: an icon over a tone. Used when there is no image, or when it fails to load. |
| `badges` | `ReactNode` |  | Badges placed on the cover, top left (status, modality). |
| `price` | `string` |  | The price, as text: "$200.000". |
| `description` | `string` |  |  |
| `meta` | `Array<{ Icon: IconType; text: string }>` |  | One line each, starting with the date. |
| `action` | `ReactNode` |  | The single way forward: a `Button` or a link. It is described by the program's title, so a list of buttons does not read "Inscribirme" five times with no context. |
| `highlight` | `CardHighlight` | `'none'` | `featured` pushes this program; `vip` is the membership. |
| `headingLevel` | `2 \| 3 \| 4` | `3` |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- **The title is a real heading**, level 3 by default (`headingLevel`), and the card is an `article`.
- **The title stays readable on any image:** it sits on a scrim that reaches the darkest ink at the bottom (7:1 or better for the title, 4.5:1 for the subtitle).
- **Images need `image.alt`.** A generated cover or a broken image falls back to a decorative cover hidden from assistive technology.
- **VIP is said in words:** the crown badge reads "Miembros", the edge shine is CSS only and stands still under reduced motion, and the hover lift is removed too.
- The action is a normal 44 px button or link.

## Content

- Title: the program's name. Subtitle: who leads it. Details: one line each, starting with the date.
